zh.title: 常見誤區：每種感測器都要一個子類別嗎？

body.text: 很多人（和 AI）的第一直覺：

class TemperatureSensor(Sensor): ...
class HumiditySensor(Sensor): ...
class VoltageSensor(Sensor): ...

rows: 同一個類別的不同物件：Sensor("T-01", "temperature", "°C")

body.text: 回想第 7 週：繼承表達的是行為上的「是一種」，不是「名字不一樣」。本案例的 ScriptedSensor 和 RandomWalkSensor 才是真正讀法不同的兩種感測器。

body.text: The department's electronics lab wants a monitoring system. The lab has temperature and humidity sensors, and also needs to monitor the output voltage of the power supply. body.text: Does it have its own data and behavior? Both → class; just one value → attribute
Is it inside the system? People or external devices using the system → actors, not classes
